messages.author: fe756cf51e487a56
messages.subject: rapache on OS X (i.e., 64 bit)
parts:
Hi, I'd like to get rapache installed on OS X10.5.4. On this platform,
Apache is 64 bit. In addition, as I use the ROracle package, I use a
64 bit R (2.9.0). However to run the 64 but version of R on the
command line I have to specify --arch x86_64

Currently when I compile rapache and run make itest I get

DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH=`/usr/bin/R RHOME`/lib:/Users/guhar/src/
rapache-1.1.8/libapreq2/library/.libs R_HOME=`/usr/bin/R RHOME` /usr/
sbin/httpd -X -f /Users/guhar/src/rapache-1.1.8/test/httpd.conf
httpd: Syntax error on line 76 of /Users/guhar/src/rapache-1.1.8/test/
httpd.conf: Cannot load /Users/guhar/src/rapache-1.1.8/.libs/mod_R.so
into server: dlopen(/Users/guhar/src/rapache-1.1.8/.libs/mod_R.so,
10): no suitable image found. Did find:\n\t/Users/guhar/src/
rapache-1.1.8/.libs/mod_R.so: mach-o, but wrong architecture
make: *** [itest] Error 1

Is there a way to indicate in the rapache build process that
everything should be 64 bit?

Thanks,

> Hi, I'd like to get rapache installed on OS X10.5.4. On this platform,
> Apache is 64 bit. In addition, as I use the ROracle package, I use a
> 64 bit R (2.9.0). However to run the 64 but version of R on the

>

> DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH=`/usr/bin/R RHOME`/lib:/Users/guhar/src/
> rapache-1.1.8/libapreq2/library/.libs R_HOME=`/usr/bin/R RHOME` /usr/

> rapache-1.1.8/.libs/mod_R.so: mach-o, but wrong architecture
> make: *** [itest] Error 1
>
> Is there a way to indicate in the rapache build process that
> everything should be 64 bit?

Try using the gcc compiler flag "-arch x86_64". And maybe you want to
configure rapache like so:

CFLAGS="-arch x86_64" ./configure --with-apache2-apxs=... --with-R=...

I'm not saying this will work, but somehow you've got to get apxs2 to
pass down that compiler flag to the actual compile step.

Thanks - some progress. I've been playing with the Makefile directly and there seem to be two things:

1. the apxs command line needs to have something like -Wl,"-arch x86_64" -Wc,"-arch x86_64" but right now apxs is only passing the extra flags to the link stage and not the compile stage

2. libapreq2 needs to be compiled with --arch x86_64 - this works fine if I manually edit the Makefile for libapreq2, but not sure how to get it passed via configure
